- Build a complete, playable WWII Eastern Front game inspired by Battlefield 1944–45, with a large trench-and-village map, USSR/Germany factions, AI soldiers, vehicles, objectives, and English/Russian UI.

- Main menu, settings, and help; English by default, with Russian selectable in settings.

- Trench digging, mounted machine guns, AI soldiers, period weapons and vehicles, aircraft, and damage/vehicle interactions.
- Responsive mobile support with landscape orientation and touch controls.

- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with a ray-cast battlefield and procedural visuals; no external game engine or asset downloads.
- Scoped down requested 50v50 to 20 AI bots (10 per side) for performance; bots respawn periodically.

- Created main menu, faction selection, settings/language selector, help screen, HUD, responsive orientation prompt, and touch-control UI.

- Complete and verify the existing WWII Eastern Front browser game, including objectives, combat, interactions, and mobile controls.

- Main menu, settings, and help; English by default with Russian selectable.
- First-person USSR/Germany gameplay with AI, capture points, and an enemy-base objective.
- Include period weapons, vehicles, aircraft, mounted guns, trench digging, and supply interactions.
- Responsive mobile support with landscape gameplay and touch controls.
- Self-contained vanilla JavaScript/Canvas implementation; no external engine or downloaded assets.
- Limit AI to 20 bots total, 10 per side.

## Decisions
- Use vanilla JavaScript, Canvas ray-cast rendering, and procedural visuals.

## Work State

- Implemented menus, faction deployment, gameplay systems, AI, objectives, rendering, HUD, and touch-control handlers in `game.js`.

- `style.css`: Responsive layout, orientation prompt, and touch-control styling.
